blocks.heading: MHT-CET PCB Career Options
rows: The core pharmacy route through MHT-CET. Covers manufacturing, quality, regulatory, clinical pharmacy, and retail-linked careers.
Biology (not maths) is the mandatory subject for these seats. Leads into agronomy, plant science, and agribusiness-linked roles.
A PCB-only entry point under the agriculture umbrella, distinct from general BSc Agriculture seats.
Also a PCB-only route within the same agriculture CET brochure, separate from the general BSc Agriculture list.
A management-leaning degree that still sits inside the agriculture CET admission list for PCB candidates.
Lab-and-research-leaning seats reachable through PCB CET scores at several Maharashtra institutes.

blocks.heading: How Competitive Is MHT-CET PCB, Really
rows: Bombay College of Pharmacy and similarly ranked institutes sit near the top of every counselling round.
Wide availability across Maharashtra once you move past the handful of flagship names.

Maharashtra runs hundreds of pharmacy seats; most students with a genuine PCB effort land somewhere in the system.

blocks.heading: MHT-CET Vs NEET for PCB Students

items.text: One national exam, 720 marks, negative marking on every wrong answer.
Opens MBBS, BDS, and AYUSH courses across the whole country.
A single all-India rank drives admission almost everywhere.
Very high stakes per question; one bad guess costs you real rank.

blocks.heading: CET Registration to an Actual Admitted Seat

items.text: Register on the official CET Cell portal during the January-February window.
Sit the PCB paper in the April exam window.
Wait for the result and your percentile, not a raw score.
Register for CAP (Centralised Admission Process) and fill your choices.
Work through the CAP rounds and confirm your seat.

blocks.heading: Actually Choose the MHT-CET PCB Route

items.text: Your actual interest is medicines, farming systems, food science, or lab biology, not treating patients.
You live in or plan to study in Maharashtra, where the state-quota advantage, lower government-aided fees, and the sheer number of seats work in your favour.
You want a lower-stakes, no-negative-marking exam rather than betting everything on a single national rank.

blocks.heading: Applying to MHT-CET From Outside Maharashtra

items.text: The exam itself, no domicile requirement to register and appear.
The All India Quota share of seats at participating colleges.
Any vacant seats released in later CAP rounds after Maharashtra-domicile candidates are allotted.
